Rendering volumetric clouds using signed distance fields
Source: GPU Gems 2: Chapter 8. Because our SDF is a volume containing arbitrary distances, the data structure we'll be using is a signed, half-precision floating point 3D texture. Each pixel in the texture represents the signed distance to the shell of our cloud volume.
